answer: Resist sybils with a dual-panel attestation bridge. A new identity locks an admission stake, then must pass two grader panels drawn from disjoint co-attestation graphs so one clique cannot vouch for all of its aliases. A falcon sentry, seeded by the epoch hash, draws both panels and later diffs phrasing, submit timing, and key lineage across the two dockets. Weight reaches the settlement summit only when both panels independently accept distinct work; cloned answers fail the cross-check and the stake is slashed, so extra keys do not buy a majority.
